checkedOccurrences.text: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
The LORD listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

wikipediaActualReadJa: Hormah記事のBiblical reference節にNumbers 14:45および21:2–3が掲げられる。Identification節は位置未知・複数候補・地区説を示す。
